card.name: Non- terms excluding the usual cause
card.fires_on: The word "non" as a negating start of a hyphenated or joined medical term, such as non-cardiovascular, non-infectious, non-melanoma or non-drug. It appears in lists of causes, events or exclusions in label text.

modes.label: Non- causes
modes.description: "non" opens a cause category contrasted with an expected one.
modes.example: Excess mortality was due to a 33% increase in<< non>>-cardiovascular causes, including malignancy

modes.label: Non- exclusions
modes.description: "non" follows "excluding" or a list item and names a condition type.
modes.example: a higher rate of malignancies (excluding<< non>>-melanoma skin cancer (NMSC

card.writes: It favors words for errors, faults and shortage and disfavors "presence", fitting a negating or absence sense.
card.plain: It fires on "non" in terms like non-infectious or non-cardiac that name causes other than the usual one.
